scope: Clarify the existing Search3 result-card hierarchy and search lifecycle states without adding another renderer, presentation layer, API request, price calculation or lead handler.
product_result: Each hotel card has one semantic heading, distinct rating and category, essential tour facts, one authoritative whole-tour total and one clear selection action.
Repeated hotel-level price and ambiguous labels were removed from the current renderer instead of hidden by another layer.
Loading, progress, empty, error, retry and form-dirty states now describe the real lifecycle and remain accessible.
Progressive empty batches no longer masquerade as terminal empty results; new searches no longer inherit the previous result count.

ota_shortlist_contract_20260909.scope: Up to three explicit complete offer snapshots, including two different rooms in the same hotel; persistent local-only TV first step.

identity.source: tourvisor only, never inferred from operator
identity.accepted_local_hotel_id: unknown unless already explicitly supplied; do not manufacture by numeric/name match

rules: Only data from one complete current projection offer, never independent room/meal combinations
savedAt means snapshot time, not supplier availability or price confirmation
Saved price always labelled historical; refresh does not implicitly make it current
Persisted snapshot is never passed directly to selectTour; require one unique match in current projection and current in-memory search generation, then existing detail/flights recheck
Filtered-out, removed, ambiguous or stale offers retain display snapshot but cannot select a substitute
No auto supplier queries, personal fields, raw payload, tokens, cookies or attribution stored
Max3 validated whitelist records; malformed/old schema/corrupt/quota/blocked storage gracefully uses in-memory fallback with explicit non-persistence message
Clear deletes stored records; accessible inline comparison preferred over a second overlay/focus trap
acceptance: AI STANDARD120k and FAMILY125k keep exact price/conditions while RO90k excluded
new search with reused offerId, missing/ambiguous identity invalidates selection
blocked/corrupt/quota storage do not break search
375/1440 keyboard save/remove/compare/return, no overflow or POST
